## Summary

Describe the user-visible or engineering outcome and the reason for the change.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant focused tests were added or updated.
- [ ] `make check` passes locally, or any unavailable check is explained below.
- [ ] HTTP, environment, ownership, or operational contract changes are reflected in `docs/context/`.
- [ ] `make context` was run when routes, models, exports, migrations, commands, or repository structure changed.
- [ ] New Supabase migrations include grants, RLS, and ownership review where applicable.
- [ ] UI changes include a screenshot or concise visual verification note.
- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, real `.env` values, generated dependency directories, or unrelated rewrites.

## Risks and follow-up

List rollout concerns, intentionally deferred work, or write `None`.
